T: Same wedding. Same day. Different snacks.
D: Two strangers get stuck reliving the same wedding day in Palm Springs over and over.
P: Serve the snacks when Nyles floats in the pool on his pizza float.
S: Nyles floating in the pool on a pizza float, forever
Pizza dough rolled thin, cut into rounds, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 220C for 10 minutes.
the wedding reception in the desert, the same one every day

Mini tostadas topped with raw tuna dressed in lime, soy and sesame, smashed avocado, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of chipotle mayo. Cut 8 small corn tortillas into rounds with a 7cm cutter, brush with oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Dice 250g sashimi-grade tuna and toss with 1 tbsp soy, the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Mash 1 avocado with salt and lime. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Top each tostada with avocado, tuna, a slice of pickled jalapeño and a dot of mayo.
Nyles and Sarah's dance at the desert bar
Halved jalapeños filled with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked until crisp.
M: another sunny day in Palm Springs
White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in warm tortillas with slaw, lime crema and pickled onion.
Reception chicken with spinach and ricotta
the wedding dinner Nyles has eaten more times than he can count

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach, ricotta and lemon, roasted golden, with a lemon caper butter sauce and crushed baby potatoes. Heat the oven to 200C. Boil 800g baby potatoes 15 minutes. Mix 150g ricotta, 60g wilted chopped spinach, 30g parmesan and lemon zest. Cut a deep pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast 18 minutes. Crush the potatoes with butter and salt. In the pan, melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over the chicken.
W: the same wedding cake, every day
Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and cream, iced white.
K: Nyles drifting in the pool with a beer, again

Cold Mexican-style lager over ice with lime, hot sauce, a dash of Worcestershire and tomato juice, in a glass rimmed with chilli salt. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire. Top slowly with 250ml cold lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge. Use soda water instead of beer for anyone not drinking.

s.note: Nyles floating in the pool on a pizza float, forever
s.how: Roll pizza dough thin and cut into small rounds. Top each with a spoon of pizza sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Eat them floating in the pool, again and again.

s.note: Nyles and Sarah's dance at the desert bar
s.how: Halve 12 large jalapeños lengthways and scrape out the seeds. Mix 200g cream cheese with 80g grated cheddar and fill each half. Wrap with half a rasher of streaky bacon and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

m.note: another sunny day in Palm Springs
m.how: Dust 600g white fish in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Quickly pickle sliced red onion in lime juice. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, fish, crema and pickled onion.

w.note: the same wedding cake, every day
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream and ice white. Serve it today, and probably tomorrow, and the day after that.

d.note: Nyles drifting in the pool with a beer, again
d.how: Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire. Top slowly with 250ml cold lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge. Use soda water instead of beer for anyone not drinking.
